items.title: Repository datasets become typed documentation inputs
items.content_text: Docs System 0.3.1 collects declared passive data for principle catalogs, labs, and dependency views without executing repository code.

items.title: Documentation becomes one safely collected public system
items.content_text: Docs System 0.3.0 adds repository-owned passive source declarations, pinned content digests, central delivery, compatibility redirects, and generated discovery blocks.

items.title: Passive Docusaurus markers enter the locked documentation corpus
items.content_text: Docs System 0.3.3 admits inert whole-line MDX comments and explicit heading ids without allowing executable expressions or changing collected bytes.

items.title: Website collection receives a Node-safe manifest entry point
items.content_text: Docs System 0.3.2 exposes manifest and source-lock operations without importing the Docusaurus UI graph into plain Node builds.

items.title: Agent Platform joins the public ecosystem surface
items.content_text: Agent Platform is now public and advertises its source, local service documentation, generated OpenAPI contract, dependencies, and first-run path through the shared b10x docs contract.

items.title: Connectors joins the public ecosystem surface
items.content_text: Connectors now exposes its catalog, architecture, adoption guides, dependencies, and current maturity through the shared b10x documentation contract.

items.title: Eventlog joins the public ecosystem surface
items.content_text: Eventlog now publishes its library boundary, crate layout, adoption path, and downstream role through the shared b10x documentation contract.

items.title: Identity joins the public ecosystem surface
items.content_text: Identity now advertises its service boundary, local adoption path, API reference, dependencies, and deployment maturity through the shared b10x documentation contract.

items.title: Agent interaction research joins public discovery
items.content_text: The reproducible interaction study now publishes its question, deterministic pipeline, adoption path, and relationship to agent guidance through the shared b10x documentation contract.

items.title: Workflow joins the public ecosystem surface
items.content_text: Workflow now publishes its product-neutral boundary, current maturity, adoption path, and dependencies through the shared b10x documentation contract.

items.title: Adoption and ecosystem changes become typed public contracts
items.content_text: Docs System 0.2.0 adds explicit first-run outcomes, repository-owned impact records, deterministic release enrichment, and RSS and JSON feeds.

items.title: Agents gain shared workspace-hygiene guidance
items.content_text: Agent Plugins 0.3.0 adds the workspace-hygiene plugin and a Worktree-generated skill for consistent, recoverable checkout lifecycle across supported agents.

items.title: Managed worktrees gain a reusable lifecycle toolchain
items.content_text: Worktree 0.1.0 publishes the embeddable lifecycle service, Git and SQLite adapters, CLI, hook protocol, and generated agent skill.

items.title: AEP becomes the canonical protocol command
items.content_text: AEP 0.40.0 establishes aep as the authored command, retains protocol as an exact compatibility alias, and keeps ESS adaptation at one optional evidence boundary.

items.title: ESS becomes a standalone executable specification toolchain
items.content_text: ESS 0.1.0 extracts system modeling, schema contracts, generators, and conformance into an independent repository with no AEP dependency.
